The 2025 Formula 1 season was the most
successful of Lando Norris’s career so far.
Following his season-opening victory in Australia, a
close title battle initially evolved with his McLaren
team-mate Oscar Piastri and the reigning world
champion Max Verstappen. However, he particu-
larly impressed during the summer with victories
in Monaco, Austria, Great Britain and Hungary.
Atechnical failure at Zandvoort temporarily set him
back, but the Briton fought his way back to the top
of the drivers’ standings with strong performances.
The title was finally decided at the last Grand Prix
of the year in Abu Dhabi. Norris went into the race
as championship leader on 408 points, ahead of
Verstappen on 396 and Piastri on 392 points. For
Norris, the situation was clear: a third-place finish
would be enough to secure the title, regardless of
Verstappen’s result.

Whilst Verstappen was battling for victory at the
front, the McLaren driver’s main priority was to
secure third place. The pressure was immense.
Even the slightest mistake could have put his
World Championship hopes at risk once again.
After 58 thrilling laps at the Yas Marina Circuit,
Verstappen finally won ahead of Piastri, whilst
Norris secured exactly the third place he needed.
He thus finished the season on 423 points - just
two points ahead of Verstappen.
After 24 races, seven victories and a breathtaking
season finale, it was done: Lando Norris became
Formula 1 World Champion for the first time in
2025, joining an illustrious line-up of McLaren
legends such as James Hunt, Niki Lauda, Alain
Prost, Ayrton Senna and Mika Häkkinen, who had
also won the title with the legendary British team.
